summary: Added the persistence layer for the proposed mypintusan (physical access control) app: apps/mypintusan/services/store_sql.go's SQLStore, a database-backed implementation of the existing Store interface built on the shared dbsql.NewGenericRepo[T] (one repo per entity -- readers, doors, credentials, holders, group memberships, grants, schedules, schedule windows, holidays, access events, access groups), with var _ Store = (*SQLStore)(nil) pinning it interchangeable with the in-memory test fake. Every child lookup (a holder's grants, a schedule's windows) deliberately goes through Get with an explicit Equal/In filter rather than dbsql.GetByForeign, because SelectByForeign still hardcodes limit=1 and would silently drop all but one child row; regression tests seed 2+ children and assert all of them come back. store_sql_test.go runs the identical end-to-end scenario from controller_test.go (badge on a simulated OSDP reader -> decision -> strike -> access event) against a REAL SQLite database via bootstrap.Ensure, not mocks, and also defines Entities() -- the 12-struct schema list this app owns, for a future app/ composition root to hand to bootstrap.Ensure. controller_test.go was refactored (newRig -> newRigWithStore + seedDefaults) so that same scenario runs over both stores. Along the way, found and documented a second data-layer inconsistency: dbsql.GetById does not return (nil, nil) for a missing row the way its own code comment claims -- SelectById's underlying Select turns an empty result set into an error ('no result found') rather than a nil map, so GetById propagates that as a wrapped error instead of a clean not-found. GetByUnique's identical-looking nil check is NOT affected (SelectByUnique genuinely returns a nil map there). The store's local isNotFound helper works around this; the misleading comment in infra/db/sql/generic_repo.go and its module doc were corrected to describe the real behavior, with no change to GetById's actual return values or error wrapping.
compatibility: mypintusan remains entirely unshipped: there is still no apps/mypintusan/app/ composition root, no apis/, no config.json, no firstrun wizard, no frontend, and nothing outside tests calls bootstrap.Ensure or NewSQLStore, so this cannot affect any running product. No fleet/myseliasan adoption exists (no wire_fleet.go, no domain/shared/fleetnode usage) -- that remains P2. The generic_repo.go comment fix is documentation-only and changes no behavior, so every existing caller of GetById across the suite is unaffected; anywhere that already special-cases a GetById error as 'not found' (by string-matching, like this new store does) continues to work exactly as before. Scope is kept at infra rather than a mypintusan app scope because apps/mypintusan has no entry in infra/versioning/version.json's apps map, and infra/versioning/bump.go's changeTargets hard-errors on an unknown scope token.
